_comment: FROZEN replay fixture for harmonic-forge#448 AC7. Do not regenerate.
This records one real confabulation: hrse#1530's Lane 1 handoff asserted
that 30 of 211 tracked contacts (14%) would be wrongly excluded from
background sync. The magnitude was wrong. The query below was run
against the live graph on the date recorded, and its result is frozen
The count is frozen rather than re-derived live because the fixture
population grows: a test that re-counted would assert a moving number
and would start failing for reasons that have nothing to do with the
code under test. What AC7 checks is that the pipeline carries a
`refuted` verdict with executed evidence attached -- not that any
particular number is still true today.
claim_under_review: 30 of 211 tracked contacts (14%) carry a status that excludes them from background sync
frozen_query: MATCH (p:Person)<-[t:TRACKING]-() WHERE p.status IS NOT NULL RETURN p.name AS name, p.status AS status ORDER BY name

frozen_result.note: Crystal Alvarez was added deliberately and carries NO status, so she is not excluded. The 14% figure counted fixture rows as if they were real contacts.

reviewer_report.summary: The exclusion-magnitude claim is refuted: 29 of the 30 rows are fixtures.

findings.claim: The handoff's '30 of 211 / 14%' figure counts test and gate fixtures as real contacts.
findings.evidence: 27 test fixtures + 2 gate fixtures + 1 real contact = 30 rows; the single real contact carries no status.

assumptions.assumption: 30 of 211 tracked contacts (14%) are wrongly excluded from background sync
assumptions.evidence:
$ cypher-shell 'MATCH (p:Person)<-[t:TRACKING]-() WHERE p.status IS NOT NULL RETURN count(*)'
30
(2026-09-01) -- of which 27 test fixtures, 2 gate fixtures, 1 real contact
